summary.one_liner: A set of notebooks and accompanying video playlist that builds up retrieval augmented generation (RAG) from basic indexing, retrieval, and generation steps.
summary.what_it_does: The README explains that LLMs are limited to a fixed training corpus, and that retrieval augmented generation grounds model output in documents fetched from an external source. The repository holds notebooks that accompany a video playlist teaching RAG step by step, starting with indexing, then retrieval, then generation. The README does not list the specific notebooks, libraries, or models used. It also gives no setup instructions. The README body is short and ends with a "Video playlist" heading that has no content in the provided text. It is listed in codecrafters-io/build-your-own-x under "Build your own AI Model" in the Python section, as "RAG for Document Search".
use_cases: learning retrieval augmented generation from scratch
following a video course on RAG
grounding LLM answers in external documents
notable: Teaching-oriented: builds RAG up from indexing, retrieval, and generation basics
Explains why RAG is used instead of fine-tuning for factual recall
